IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, glossy, wavy
black hair and layered gold chain necklaces stands
in a full-length portrait. She wears a black tweed
cropped jacket with gold-trimmed edges and
jeweled buttons, over a matching black tweed
A-line midi skirt with patch pockets. She carries a
small black leather bag and wears black slingback
heels. Her expression is calm and composed. A
pale gray studio backdrop with a dark gray floor
and soft even light. Palette of black, charcoal, and
gold. Elegant and classic, in the style of a luxury
tweed lookbook.
